title: President Murmu Presents National Sports Awards; Lalremsiami Honoured
indian_angle: The National Sports Awards recognize top Indian athletes and coaches, with Lalremsiami making history for Mizoram.
summary: President Murmu awarded the National Sports Awards, with Lalremsiami becoming the first from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award, among 17 recipients and three Dronacharya awardees.

title: Lakshya Sen Reaches Kumamoto Masters Semifinals, Srikanth Exits
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen's strong performance in a Super 500 tournament keeps his hopes alive for the season-ending BWF World Tour Finals.
summary: World No. 13 Lakshya Sen defeated Japan's Yushi Tanaka 21-16, 21-15 to advance to the semifinals of the Kumamoto Masters Japan, while fellow Indian Srikanth bowed out.

title: Vivaan Kapoor Wins Trap Silver, Secures India's LA 2028 Olympic Quota
indian_angle: Vivaan Kapoor's silver medal performance directly secured an Olympic quota for India in shooting for the LA 2028 Games.
summary: Vivaan Kapoor won a trap silver medal, making him the fourth Indian men's trap shooter to secure an Olympic quota for India for the LA 2028 Games.

title: Ambekar, Gunjan Win Historic Boxing Golds at Youth Olympics
indian_angle: Indian boxers Ambekar and Gunjan achieved historic gold medals at the Youth Olympics, with Gunjan becoming the first Indian woman to do so.
summary: Ambekar and Gunjan secured gold medals in boxing at the Youth Olympics, with Gunjan becoming India's first woman to achieve this feat.
